title: 第1章 吾为截教大师兄开启收徒系统第2章 检测到残破先天魔神残魂首次收徒暴击奖励
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 洪荒。
昆仑山山脉。
瑶草奇花不谢，青松翠柏长春。
千株老柏，带雨满山青染染；万节修篁，含烟一径色苍苍。
此处不愧为洪荒天地祖脉，混沌元气浩瀚涌动，先天灵气浓郁化雾，可见天穹祥瑞化兽，彩凤麒麟呈祥，乃是洪荒罕有的仙山福地。
上清峰。
仙音缥缈、道韵磅礴。
天花乱坠地涌金莲，无边金光洒落苍穹，阵阵仙蕴神光绽放九天，此处为盘古元神所化三清之一的上清通天教主所在讲道。
下列，弟子千数。
最为首者乃是位高大挺拔、丰神俊逸的翩翩青年。
面冠如玉，温文儒雅，仙气缥缈、剑眉星眸。
此人不是别人，正是上清首徒青渊。
上清法门传入耳中，青渊端坐认真倾听，但心底有些无奈。
太玄妙了啊，越说听不懂。
说来，青渊并非洪荒本土生灵，而是在意外中穿越到一朵青莲身上，化形成功并且运气好拜师通天教主，成为了截教首徒。
只可惜自己的跟脚很低。
不过是中品后天生灵跟脚，在洪荒时代里毫不起眼。
若非心诚，加上本体为青莲让通天教主动容，方才拜入上清通天门下。
成为门内首徒，并没有让青渊想象中的好处多，相反各种问题也随之而来。
因为上清通天认为万物皆有一线机缘，弟子也当自寻一线机缘，而非方方面面皆由他管辖指点，故而向来只教门徒不管事务。
往后。
他的地位遭到了质疑。
后面加入的二师弟多宝道人以及大量同门并不服他，屡屡挑战他的权威。
想来也是，自己不过后天生灵，玄仙境初期，论福缘跟脚资质实力都比不过多宝道人这极品先天生灵的洪荒异种多宝鼠，洪荒向来以拳头说话，自然不会有人理会他。
哪怕他是上清首徒，也无济于事。
咚！
咚咚！
突然间，昆仑山山脉之中响起一阵惊天动地的钟响磬声，随后金光璀璨、道韵缥缈，无穷道韵降落于万万里外玉清山脉麒麟崖上。
祥云铺天，金花盖地。
见此声势，上清一脉弟子无不惊呼连连。
哪怕是通天教主，眼中亦是有异光闪动，脸上露出欢喜：“看来要恭喜二兄又收弟子了！”
眼下紫霄宫方才三讲过后。
先是女娲圣人撰土造人补全洪荒成圣。
三清立教引开天功德成圣。
西方二释不甘落后，立下大宏愿而成圣。
接连成圣使得洪荒万类轰动，同时获得鸿蒙紫气的红云老祖因遭嫉妒而被鲲鹏老祖追杀陨落，令人唏嘘。
三清成圣，各立道统。
在大道理念上的分歧虽有，可亿万万年的兄弟情义还是压过这点分歧的。
注视着远方麒麟崖上敲响金钟玉磬引发的种种异象，青渊沉默肃然。
他那位二师伯元始天尊只收福缘深厚、跟脚不凡的生灵为徒，走的是质量。
content_en:
Ancient times.
Kunlun Mountains.
The wonderful flowers of Yao Cao never fade, and the green pines and cypresses last forever.
Thousands of old cypress trees are dyed green all over the mountain with the rain; thousands of knots are being repaired, and the entire path is gray with smoke.
This place is worthy of being regarded as the ancestral line of the ancient world. The chaotic energy surges vastly, the innate spiritual energy is rich and turns into mist. You can see the auspiciousness of the sky transforming into beasts, and the colorful phoenixes and unicorns showing their auspiciousness. It is a rare fairyland blessed land in the ancient times.
Shangqing Peak.
The fairy sound is ethereal and the Taoist rhyme is majestic.
Golden lotuses surged from the sky, boundless golden light spilled into the sky, and bursts of immortal light bloomed for nine days. This is where the leader of Shangqing Tongtian, one of the Three Pure Ones transformed by Pangu Yuanshen, was preaching.
Below, there are thousands of disciples.
The most prominent one is a tall, erect, graceful and graceful young man.
The face is like jade, gentle and elegant, with an ethereal fairy aura, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes.
This person is none other than Qingyuan, the leader of the Qing Dynasty.
When the Shangqing Dharma was introduced into his ears, Qingyuan sat upright and listened carefully, but he felt helpless in his heart.
It's so mysterious, the more I talk about it, the harder I understand.
Speaking of which, Qingyuan was not a native creature from the ancient world, but accidentally traveled to a green lotus, successfully transformed into a green lotus, and luckily became the disciple of the Tongtian Cult Master, becoming the first disciple of the Jie Cult.
It's a pity that my heels are very low.
They were just mid-level acquired creatures, and they were inconspicuous in the prehistoric era.
If he is not sincere and his true body is Qinglian, and the Tongtian Sect takes the initiative, he will become a disciple of the Shangqing Tongtian Sect.
Becoming the first disciple in the sect did not bring many benefits as Qing Yuan imagined. On the contrary, various problems also came with it.
Because Shangqing Tongtian believes that everything has a chance, and disciples should also look for a chance, instead of having all aspects under his control and guidance, so he has always taught his disciples to ignore affairs.
later.
His status was questioned.
The second junior fellow apprentice, Taoist Duobao, who joined later, and a large number of his fellow disciples were not convinced by him and repeatedly challenged his authority.
Thinking about it, he is not an acquired creature. In the early stage of Xuanxian Realm, in terms of luck and qualifications, he cannot compare with Taoist Duobao, a supreme innate creature from the ancient times. He has always spoken with his fists, so naturally no one will pay attention to him.
Even if he is the first disciple of Shangqing, it will not help.
Boom!
Boom!
Suddenly, there was an earth-shattering sound of bells and chimes in the Kunlun Mountains, and then bright golden light, ethereal Taoist rhymes, and infinite Taoist rhymes landed on the Qilin Cliff of the Yuqing Mountains thousands of miles away.
Auspicious clouds cover the sky, and golden flowers cover the ground.
Seeing this momentum, all the disciples of Shangqing lineage exclaimed in surprise.
Even the leader of Tongtian Cult had a strange light flashing in his eyes, and his face showed joy: "It seems that I want to congratulate the second brother for accepting another disciple!"
At present, Zixiao Palace has just finished its third lecture.
First, the saint Nuwa created earth and created humans to complete the prehistoric times and become a saint.
The establishment of the Sanqing religion led to the enlightenment of heavenly merits and virtues and led to sainthood.
The second Western Buddhism was unwilling to lag behind and set great ambitions to become a saint.
The successive sainthoods caused a sensation in the world. At the same time, the Hongyun ancestor who obtained the Hongmeng Purple Qi was chased and killed by the Kunpeng ancestor due to jealousy, which is sad.
The Three Pure Ones became saints and each established a Taoist tradition.
Although there are differences in the concept of the great road, the billions of years of brotherhood still outweigh these differences.
Qingyuan was silent and solemn as he watched the various strange phenomena caused by the ringing of golden bells and jade chimes on Qilin Cliff in the distance.
His second uncle, Yuanshi Tianzun, only accepts as his disciples those who have deep blessings and extraordinary abilities, and he works with quality.
